sources.title: GitHub - canopyai/Orpheus-TTS: Towards Human-Sounding Speech
sources.snippet: Orpheus TTS is a SOTA open-source text-to-speech system built on the Llama-3b backbone. Orpheus demonstrates the emergent capabilities of using LLMs for speech synthesis.
